note.summary:
2.2 Customs, festivals and celebrations
Key focus
- traditions, family occasions, food, festivals and celebrations.

Core language
- Useful structures: secondo me; penso che; mi piace perché; l’anno scorso; in futuro; di solito; dovrei/dovremmo.
- Use past tense for previous celebrations, present tense for customs and future tense for planned events.

Exam tips
- For comprehension, locate the exact word or phrase that proves each answer.
- In translation, preserve tense, negatives, quantities and relationships between people.
- In writing, add opinions and reasons, vary time frames, and check verb and adjective agreement.

questions.examTip: Read the complete sentence before answering; check time phrases, negatives and the relationship between the main words.
questions.modelAnswer: In Italy we celebrate Christmas with family and a long lunch.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Italian sentence and answer in English:

“In Italia festeggiamo il Natale con la famiglia e un pranzo lungo.”

How is Christmas celebrated?

questions.examTip: Read the complete sentence before answering; check time phrases, negatives and the relationship between the main words.
questions.modelAnswer: My birthday is in April and every year I invite a few friends.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Italian sentence and answer in English:

“Il mio compleanno è in aprile e ogni anno invito pochi amici.”

When is the birthday, and who comes to the celebration?

questions.examTip: Read the complete sentence before answering; check time phrases, negatives and the relationship between the main words.
questions.modelAnswer: At Easter we decorated eggs and made a cake.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Italian sentence and answer in English:

“A Pasqua abbiamo decorato le uova e preparato una torta.”

Give two things done at Easter.

questions.examTip: Read the complete sentence before answering; check time phrases, negatives and the relationship between the main words.
questions.modelAnswer: During Carnival many children wear colourful costumes.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Italian sentence and answer in English:

“Durante il Carnevale molti bambini indossano costumi colorati.”

Who wears colourful costumes, and when?

questions.examTip: Read the complete sentence before answering; check time phrases, negatives and the relationship between the main words.
questions.modelAnswer: Next year I will take part in the village festival with my grandparents.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Italian sentence and answer in English:

“L’anno prossimo parteciperò alla festa del paese con i miei nonni.”

What future celebration is planned, and with whom?

questions.examTip: Read the complete sentence before answering; check time phrases, negatives and the relationship between the main words.
questions.modelAnswer: I prefer traditional celebrations because they bring together people of different ages.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Italian sentence and answer in English:

“Preferisco le feste tradizionali perché uniscono persone di età diverse.”

Why are traditional celebrations preferred?
